import pytest
from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch
from subject import check_eval_regression, ModelEvalRegressionResult, DEFAULT_REGRESSION_THRESHOLD
from omnibase_core.models.governance.model_eval_report import ModelEvalReport
from omnibase_core.models.governance.model_eval_summary import ModelEvalSummary


def _make_report(total_tasks=10, onex_worse_count=4, report_id="rep-1", suite_id="suite-1"):
    summary = ModelEvalSummary(
        total_tasks=total_tasks,
        onex_worse_count=onex_worse_count,
    )
    return ModelEvalReport(
        report_id=report_id,
        suite_id=suite_id,
        summary=summary,
    )


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_regression_detected_when_ratio_exceeds_threshold():
    report = _make_report(total_tasks=10, onex_worse_count=4)
    result = check_eval_regression(report, threshold=0.30)
    assert result.is_regression is True
    assert result.worse_count == 4
    assert result.total_tasks == 10
    assert result.worse_ratio == pytest.approx(0.4)
    assert result.threshold == 0.30
    assert result.report_id == "rep-1"
    assert result.suite_id == "suite-1"


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_no_regression_when_ratio_equals_threshold():
    report = _make_report(total_tasks=10, onex_worse_count=3)
    result = check_eval_regression(report, threshold=0.30)
    assert result.is_regression is False
    assert result.worse_ratio == pytest.approx(0.3)


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_no_regression_when_ratio_below_threshold():
